summary:
Frontend-only E2E verification of the Go Perks 'Give a month, get a month' referral feature. ALL BRIEF ITEMS PASSED.

=== /dashboard (member@tinysvouchers.com.au) ===
- referral-card visible, not on business accounts (verified below).
- referral-link shows site/join?ref=REFHF11GI (format correct).
- referral-copy-btn -> navigator.clipboard + toast 'Link copied' visible.
- referral-share-btn rendered.
- referral-whatsapp-btn href starts with https://wa.me/?text= and the url-encoded referral link appears inside the message text.
- referral-progress reads '0 of 12 free months earned this year.' (correct baseline).
- 390px and 1440px: card renders cleanly at both widths (screenshot confirmed at 390).

=== Friend flow (fresh browser context) ===
- /join?ref=NOPE (invalid): no referral-banner rendered (count=0). PASS.
- /join?ref=REFHF11GI: referral-banner shows '<Demo> invited you. Join and pay, and you'll both get a free month: 13 months for the price of 12.' at both 1440 and 390 widths.
- Clicking checkout-btn as guest navigates to /register?next=%2Fjoin. PASS.
- Register NEW member test_ref_ui_o2sos2oj@example.com (fields: auth-name-input, auth-email-input, auth-password-input, auth-confirm-password-input). After submit, /api/auth/me returned 200 with role=member and the new user id.
- MongoDB check: users.find_one({email:test_ref_ui_o2sos2oj}) -> referred_by == '6aea79dddbf80d8e3afeb066' which == the Demo member's _id. attach_referrer wired correctly.
- Back on /join, clicking checkout-btn redirected to https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_a1No... (Stripe hosted checkout). PASS. Did not complete payment.

=== /admin/emails (admin@tinysvouchers.com.au) ===
- template-item-referral_reward is rendered with label 'Referral free month' in the sidebar 'EMAILS TO MEMBERS' section (confirmed by screenshot of the sidebar and the ordering in the DOM between 'Gift membership' and the 'EMAILS TO PARTNERS' heading).
- Clicking it loads the editor: Subject 'You've earned a free month of {brand}', Heading 'A free month, on us', Opening text 'Hi {first_name}, {friend} just joined {brand} with your link, so you've both earned a free month.\n\n{reward_line}'.
- Live preview iframe (inside [data-testid=template-preview]) srcdoc length 1280 bytes rendering: 'A free month, on us ... Hi Tony, Sam just joined Go Perks with your link, so you've both earned a free month. Your membership now runs until 4 December 2027. Keep sharing your link. You can earn up to 12 free months a year. Share my link'. PASS.
- No save/reset performed; left admin templates untouched.

=== Business account /dashboard (business@tinysvouchers.com.au via /business/login) ===
- API: GET /api/me/referral -> 403 'Only members have a referral link'.
- UI: /dashboard referral-card count = 0. PASS (not shown for business accounts).

=== Cleanup ===
- test_ref_ui_o2sos2oj@example.com deleted via users.delete_many({email:/^test_ref_ui_/}) -> 1 doc removed.
- Demo member's referral counters remain untouched (no paid friend -> no reward applied), which is correct per spec (reward happens on pay, not on signup).
critical_code_review_comments: ReferralCard.jsx: Good - gracefully returns null when /me/referral fails or no link. Clipboard toast uses optional chaining; falls back to error toast. WhatsApp link opens in new tab with rel=noreferrer.

Join.jsx: captureRef() on mount persists ref code to localStorage; getRef() is read on checkout POST so the Stripe session is correctly tagged with the referrer. Invalid ref codes fail the /referrals/{code} fetch quietly so the banner never appears - good UX.
referral.js: Only accepts /^[A-Z0-9]{4,20}$/i codes before storing - sane input validation.
Admin email template 'referral_reward' is grouped under 'EMAILS TO MEMBERS' as per brief; live preview wires through the normal debounced iframe pipeline and shows reward copy correctly.

Not a defect but worth noting: the [data-testid=template-preview] wrapper is a div with an inner iframe (no testid). Reading srcdoc off the wrapper returns 0. Tests should target the inner iframe or use contentDocument. Previous iteration reports read srcdoc directly; may want to add data-testid to the iframe itself for consistency.

success_rate.backend: not tested this iteration (per brief - backend has 129 passing tests)
success_rate.frontend: 100% - all 5 brief items verified end-to-end (dashboard card + copy/share/whatsapp/progress, friend banner + invalid-ref hidden, register+link+Stripe redirect, admin referral_reward template with live preview, business account hides card, responsive at 390/1440).

test_credentials: Used as documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Created & deleted: test_ref_ui_o2sos2oj@example.com / Test!2026Abc.
seed_data_creation: 1 TEST_ member user created during friend-flow registration (test_ref_ui_o2sos2oj@example.com) - deleted via MongoDB users.delete_many({email:/^test_ref_ui_/}) returning 1. No other seed data created. No admin templates saved/reset.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Testids verified: referral-card, referral-link, referral-copy-btn, referral-share-btn, referral-whatsapp-btn, referral-progress, referral-banner, checkout-btn, template-item-referral_reward, template-preview (wrapper div - the actual iframe is inside without testid, read srcdoc via document.querySelector('[data-testid=template-preview] iframe').srcdoc). Auth form uses auth-name-input/auth-email-input/auth-password-input/auth-confirm-password-input (not register-*). Admin login uses admin-login-email/admin-login-password and button text 'Sign in'. Partner login button text is 'Log in'. Demo member referral_code = REFHF11GI, _id = 6aea79dddbf80d8e3afeb066. Business account's /api/me/referral returns 403 and /dashboard renders no referral-card. attach_referrer links by referral_code at signup and stores user _id string in users.referred_by.
rca of the issue: No defects found. Implementation matches the spec end-to-end: (a) Member sees give-a-month-get-a-month card with clipboard/share/whatsapp/12-month-cap progress; (b) Friend sees inviter banner on /join?ref=CODE (invalid codes hide banner); checkout-btn gate-keeps guests to /register?next=/join and the new account is linked via users.referred_by = member._id string; subsequent checkout-btn opens Stripe hosted checkout with ref passed to /payments/checkout; (c) Admin /emails has a new 'Referral free month' template under EMAILS TO MEMBERS with a working live-preview iframe showing subject/heading/body/CTA; (d) Business accounts are blocked at both the API (403) and the UI (card not rendered).
